$$
{{[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 12 & 9 & 0 \\ 9 & 7 & -12\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 4 & 1 & 0 \\ 3 & \boxed{} & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 20 \\ 0 & 0 & -17\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry ${l}_{32}$ in the matrix $L?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14155922/assets/bc5a9e965ceb4fbcef5643bb009a8d78a47ea229e52c13e256ba9c0942d286bf.svg)

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry $l_{31}$ in the matrix $L?$
current_example.worked_solution:
We want to make $0$ at the position $a_{{\color{blue}3}{\color{red}1}}$ using Gaussian elimination. To do this, we take the ${\color{blue}3}$rd row of $A,$ and we add the ${\color{red}1}$st row of $A$ multiplied by ${\color{purple}-4}{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & -6 & 1 \\ 4 & 8 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & -6 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The entry $l_{{\color{blue}3}{\color{red}1}}$ of the matrix $L$ is the factor next to $R_1,$ taken with the opposite sign:

$$
l_{31}=-({\color{purple}-4})=4
$$
